postprocess_mesh: postprocess a mesh by simplifying with quadric edge collapse and removing invisible faces using multiview rasterization
fill_holes: fill holes in a mesh by rasterizing from multiple views and solving a mincut problem on the dual graph
parametrize_mesh: parametrize a mesh to UV texture space using xatlas for subsequent texture baking
bake_texture: bake a texture onto a parametrized mesh from multiple observations using fast splatting or gradient-based optimization
to_glb: convert a Strivec or Gaussian appearance representation with an extracted mesh into a textured trimesh GLB object
